extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive Multi-modal Video understanding Benchmark (MVBench) that covers 20 challenging video tasks requiring temporal understanding. It is built by transforming static image tasks into dynamic video tasks and automatically converting public video annotations into multiple-choice QAs.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.publisher: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai AI Laboratory; The University of Hong Kong; Fudan University; State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Videos are selected from 11 existing public video benchmarks. Short clips with negligible motions and extremely long videos with overly complicated contexts are eliminated. Videos with intermediate duration (5s to 35s) are selected. Questions and multiple-choice options are automatically generated from the public video annotations using LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 11 public video benchmarks including STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, and TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For STAR, start or end points of video clips are randomly shifted. For CLEVRER, questions needing more than 10 conditions are excluded. For all questions, 3 to 5 answer options are randomly sampled and shuffled. LLMs are used to ensure answer options have similar and reasonable lengths.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering out short clips (minimal movement) and extremely long videos (complicated context), keeping videos with intermediate duration (5s to 35s).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic QA generation paradigm converting open-sourced video annotations into multiple-choice QAs via LLMs. ChatGPT generates a question for each video based on task definition. Answer options are constructed either directly from ground truth annotations (Template-Based Construction) or generated by ChatGPT (LLM-Based Generation).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the temporal perception capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in the open world.
